projects.problem: Medical professionals struggle to accurately diagnose patients in real-time, leading to delayed treatment and potential misdiagnosis.
projects.goal: To provide a seamless and accurate diagnostic experience for medical professionals through real-time collaboration and AI-powered image processing.

key_features.text: Real-time collaboration and image processing
Scalable and secure architecture
LLM-based diagnostic reports

projects.title: Trellis
projects.one_liner: An interactive concept mapping and document intelligence platform that transforms unstructured knowledge into fluid, force-directed graph visualizations and executive summaries.
projects.problem: Readers, researchers, and engineers face severe cognitive fatigue when navigating dense, unstructured documents (such as research papers, system RFCs, and academic articles) due to the absence of clear visual concept hierarchies and relationship maps.
projects.goal: To engineer an end-to-end document intelligence platform that autonomously transforms unstructured prose into interactive, force-directed concept graphs and executive summaries using an asynchronous AI extraction worker, a high-throughput Rust GraphQL gateway, and an Angular 18 reactive canvas.

key_features.text: Interactive force-directed visual canvas with Obsidian dark aesthetics, dynamic category coloring, and real-time physics
Asynchronous multi-service pipeline decoupling ingestion from AI synthesis via Rust Axum GraphQL gateway and background TypeScript polling worker
Executive summary inspector with concept confidence meters, key-value metadata drawers, and a $0 zero-cost deterministic offline fallback engine

performance.text: Achieves sub-10ms GraphQL query latency and eliminates N+1 database queries through async-graphql DataLoaders

scale.text: Decouples synchronous API handling from intensive AI graph extraction via background polling and queue workers

utility.text: Guarantees 100% offline reproducibility with deterministic $0 mock extractors, strict Zod schemas, and transactional rollbacks

projects.title: Lupus Lens
projects.one_liner: A clinical decision-support interface for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) screening, combining retinal imaging with gene expression analysis via a Swin-SNN cross-modal fusion model.
projects.problem: Clinicians face significant challenges detecting Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) early due to heterogeneous systemic presentations, while conventional diagnostic workflows struggle to synthesize complex multi-modal biomarkers like ocular retinal pathology and high-dimensional transcriptomic profiles.
projects.goal: To develop an integrated clinical screening platform that fuses non-invasive retinal fundus imaging with a 20-gene transcriptomic expression panel using a Swin-SNN deep learning model, synthetic microarray generation, and real-time Grad-CAM explainability.

key_features.text: Cross-modal Swin-SNN inference combining retinal fundus imaging with 20-gene expression vectors
Two-way microarray converter mapping 20-gene Log2FC vectors to 4×5 spatial heatmaps using Canvas DSP
Explainable clinical diagnostics with dual-layer Grad-CAM overlays, gene contribution charts, and risk stratification

scale.text: Maintains patient registries, assessment histories, and scan persistence using Supabase relational database and storage

utility.text: Empowers clinicians with transparent Grad-CAM attention maps and quantified per-gene risk contributions

Instant Cath Lab Pre-Alerts & Audit Trail Tracking

projects.title: KaagapAI
projects.one_liner: An offline-first clinical decision-support and supply chain orchestration platform for Barangay Health Workers and Rural Health Units, featuring AI triage, multilingual referral handoffs, and predictive inventory forecasting.
projects.problem: Barangay Health Workers (BHWs) and Rural Health Units (RHUs) in underserved Philippine communities face critical challenges with paper-bound records, manual triage errors, delayed emergency hospital handoffs, and unexpected medication stockouts due to spotty connectivity.
projects.goal: To engineer an accessible, offline-first digital healthcare workstation that empowers frontline workers with structured 5-step AI clinical triage, automated multilingual referral handoffs (English, Cebuano, Filipino), predictive pharmaceutical inventory forecasting, and an intelligent context-aware copilot (Maya).

key_features.text: 5-step structured clinical triage intake analyzing vitals, symptom clusters, and danger signs for instant risk stratification
Multilingual referral handoffs generating localized patient instructions in English, Cebuano (Bisaya), and Filipino (Tagalog)
Predictive supply forecasting modeling consumption velocities and active case trends to alert on impending stockouts
